description: Lists the developer's projects with their apps, plan, quota pool and connections (Stripe, Cloudflare, database, cloud), each marked as the project's own or inherited from the account. team: who sees every app of a project. cloudflare_setup: the steps, a pre-filled link that creates the token and the panelUrl where the developer pastes it (never in the chat). Changing them: neblla_projects. More: neblla_get_llms tools/projects_read

action.description: "list", "team", "cloudflare_setup" or "cloudflare_check". By action: team {projectId}; cloudflare_check {projectId?}; cloudflare_setup {projectId?}

projectId.description: The project, from list; left out in the Cloudflare actions, it is the account's.

name: neblla_projects_read
title: Read projects
